content:
Apple today released iOS 26.6.1, bringing a new software update to iPhone that fixes more than 20 security vulnerabilities. Details below.

Apple releases security update notes for iOS 26.6.1 and other systems

While iOS 27 is about to launch, Apple today still rolled out a security-focused software update for iOS 26 and its companion platforms including macOS and visionOS.

iOS 26.6.1 is now available, fixing more than 20 security vulnerabilities on iPhone according to Apple's security update notes.

Most of the fixes involve WebKit, but also include patches for Audio, ImageIO, Kernel, and other components.

You can view the full security details via the link below:

Release notes for visionOS 26.6.1 have not yet been published. Apple's official website only states they will be "announced later." However, the vast majority of content is expected to be the same as other Apple platforms.

With just weeks to go before the expected launch of iOS 27, today's update is likely to be the last one we see before iOS 27 arrives.

Apple previously stated plans to release software updates containing security patches more frequently in the future. This is due to the increasing risk of AI-driven cyberattacks.
